description: Search live job and internship listings in India, newest first. Filter by keywords (role, skill or company), city, and type. Returns up to 24 per page, each with a short description and a link.

location.description: City, e.g. Bangalore, Delhi NCR, Pune, or Remote. Omit for anywhere.

query.description: Keywords: role, skill or company, e.g. "data analyst" or "react". Omit to browse the newest.

type.description: Only when the user asked for a specific type.

name: search_jobs
title: Search Indian jobs and internships
